name: Kurigram

queries.query: Kurigram Bangladesh official cadastral map land records GIS parcel map service
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official Kurigram District government site, the Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), the Settlement online land-record/map viewer, and the official DLRS integrated online Mouza-map purchase portal. The sources establish an official land-record/map service, but discovery did not expose a public Kurigram parcel layer or stable parcel-ID-plus-geometry API response.

queries.query: কুড়িগ্রাম বাংলাদেশ সরকারি মৌজা মানচিত্র খতিয়ান ভূমি সেবা জিআইএস
queries.result: প্রথম পক্ষের ফলাফলে কুড়িগ্রাম জেলা সরকারি সাইটের ভূমি-সেবা ও রেকর্ড রুম, ভূমি রেকর্ড ও জরিপ অধিদপ্তর, এবং অনলাইন ভূমি রেকর্ড ও জরিপ ব্যবস্থাপনার ম্যাপ অনুসন্ধান সেবা পাওয়া গেছে। কুড়িগ্রাম জেলার জন্য সরকারি ম্যাপ/রেকর্ড সেবা প্রমাণিত, কিন্তু বেনামী পার্সেল আইডি-সহ জ্যামিতি ফিচার বা প্রকাশ্য পার্সেল API পাওয়া যায়নি।

registryEvidence.custodian: Kurigram District Administration record-room service and the Bangladesh Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS) Settlement map service.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: The local Kurigram government page documents citizen access to khatian records and Mouza maps through the district record room; the national DLRS viewer provides district/survey/upazila/mouza/sheet map controls. This is local registry/map-service evidence, not proof of open citywide parcel API coverage.

parcelDiscovery.boundedResponse: Kurigram district boundary returned as a JSON Feature with MultiPolygon coordinates; no parcel feature was retained because it is administrative geometry and not a parcel polygon. The survey-to-upazila request for Kurigram returned an empty JSON list.
parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as a citywide absence test.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP 200. Current JavaScript configuration exposed the public POST routes /Map/GetDivisionList, /Khatian/getdistrictlistdivisionwise, /Khatian/GetSurveyListDistrictWise, /Khatian/GetThanaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetMouzaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetMouzaListBySurveyMapForshet, and /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey. No login was used.
HTTP 200 with division list; Rangpur division was identified as unitcode 080000000.
HTTP 200 with district list; Kurigram was identified as unitcode 080200000 and comcod 4186.
HTTP 200 with one survey record for Kurigram: rsnum 201901, RS (BRS), described as a digital survey and marked চলমান.
HTTP 200 with an empty JSON list for comcod=4186, rsno1=201901, districtid=080200000. This is an endpoint/data result for the supplied route, not evidence of citywide absence.

HTTP 200 for unitcode=080200000. Returned an administrative Kurigram district Feature with MultiPolygon geometry and properties including NAME_2=Kurigram; no parcel schema or parcel identity was present, so it was not retained.

HTTP 200. Official DLRS integrated online Mouza-map purchase portal describes CS, SA, RS, BRS, and BDS map products and location/sheet search, but no anonymous parcel geometry response was requested or exposed in the inspected landing page configuration.
HTTP 200. Local record-room page states that requested khatian copies, Mouza maps, and searches are supplied; it documents a local custodian/service but provides no machine-readable parcel layer.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only if publicly exposed and source-proven
uncertainty: The public viewer may require a valid survey/upazila/mouza selection or may have incomplete current data for this route; the empty upazila response is not a citywide absence finding.
The district boundary response is administrative geometry, not parcel geometry, and was not retained as a parcel sample.
No credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address fields, or TLS exception was used.
Independent serial review is required before any adapter or runtime qualification.
